profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Tap your avatar to open your card. In the settings, “Switch profile” moves between profiles; each one has its own code.

library.title: The library
library.body: Every book of the family, with filters by status, language and tag.

newBook.title: Create a book
newBook.body: Add a book page by page or with its ISBN. You can save it at any time and finish it later.

studio.title: The recording studio
studio.body: Books waiting for a voice are here. Each character has its own voice: yours, a relative’s or a child’s. Listen again and retry as often as you like.

review.title: Review
review.body: Recordings that were sent wait for your opinion: approve them or ask for a new take with a comment.

trash.title: The trash
trash.body: A deleted book stays here for 30 days. You can restore it before it disappears for good.

family.title: My family
family.body: This tab opens the family area: members, invitation codes and schedule.

members.title: Members and invitations
members.body: Add a relative or a parent with an invitation code or a link valid for 48 hours.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Choose the hours when each child can use the app. Outside those hours the screen stays locked.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: Offer a book to another family, or approve the sharing requests waiting for you here.

treasure.title: The treasure box
treasure.body: Messages you want to keep forever. The box holds 10 at most.

activity.title: Activity
activity.body: See who did what: books created, recordings, messages. Filter by person.

replay.title: Replay the tour
replay.body: You can restart this tour at any time from the settings.

children.title: Home with the children
children.body: Each child of the family appears here with their photo and the number of messages you left them.

message.title: Send a message
message.body: Tap a child, record your voice and send. You can leave up to 5 messages per child.

record.title: Record a book
record.body: Books the family asks you to read aloud appear here. Tap one to record your voice.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: The bell lets you know when a child listened to your message or a new request arrives.

replay.title: Replay the tour
replay.body: You can restart this tour at any time from the settings.
